# LumaDesk Pro — 45-Second Launch Video Plan + Computer-Use Workflow

All deliverables below are **plans and specifications only**. No tools were run, no files were created, and no browser actions were performed. Product facts are treated as fixed: local document organizer, CNY 299, launch 2026-10-18, **no video export**, **no offline sync**.

---

## 1. Timed Shot List (exactly 45.0 s)

| # | Time | Duration | Shot | Visual direction | Narration | Caption |
|---|------|----------|------|------------------|-----------|---------|
| 1 | 0.0–4.0 | 4.0 s | Cold open: chaotic desktop | Screen recording of a cluttered desktop; 40+ loose files, overlapping windows. Slow 5% push-in. Cool desaturated grade. | "Your desktop isn't a filing system. It's a pile." | Your desktop is a pile. |
| 2 | 4.0–9.0 | 5.0 s | Problem montage | Three quick cuts: misfiled invoice, duplicate scan, lost contract. Each 1.6 s, hard cuts on beat. Red highlight boxes. | "Invoices in Downloads. Contracts in Screenshots. Nothing where you left it." | Invoices in Downloads. Contracts in Screenshots. |
| 3 | 9.0–14.0 | 5.0 s | Product reveal | LumaDesk Pro logo animates in over clean UI. Warm key light, soft shadow. Logo holds 1.5 s. | "Meet LumaDesk Pro — the local document organizer." | LumaDesk Pro — local document organizer |
| 4 | 14.0–21.0 | 7.0 s | Core action: auto-sort | Screen capture: drag 12 files into LumaDesk; they snap into labeled folders (Finance, Contracts, Receipts). 1.2× speed. Cursor visible. | "Drop files in. LumaDesk sorts them locally — by type, date, and project." | Drop in. Sorted locally. |
| 5 | 21.0–27.0 | 6.0 s | Search + preview | Type "Q3 lease" in search bar; result appears in 0.4 s; preview pane opens.
